title: Cyber Crime Helpline & Online Police Complaint in Bangladesh 2026: CID, DB Cyber & Facebook Harassment
metaTitle: Cyber Crime Helpline Bangladesh 2026 | Police Online Complaint
metaDescription: How to report cyber blackmail, fake Facebook accounts, and online financial fraud in Bangladesh. Emergency hotline numbers 01320000888 and 999 police procedure.
heroIntro: Victims of online blackmail, fake social media profiles, non-consensual image sharing, and cyber extortion can seek swift redress through the Police Cyber Support for Women (PCSW), CID Cyber Police Centre (CPC), and DB Cyber Crime Division. Authored by Advocate Md. Shah Alam, Supreme Court Advocate. Call our Uttara chamber at 01712655546.

quickAnswer.heading: ⚡ Emergency Cyber Helplines (24/7)
points: Digital Evidence: Preserve unedited screenshots, profile URLs, message headers, and transaction IDs.

sections.heading: 1. Official Cyber Crime Reporting Wings
sections.content: Specialized units include Police Cyber Support for Women, CID Cyber Police Centre (CPC), and Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) Counter Terrorism and Transnational Crime (CTTC) Cyber Division.

sections.heading: 2. Step-by-Step Police Station GD & Cyber Complaint
sections.content: Lodge a General Diary (GD) at your local police station accompanied by printed screenshot exhibits and URL identifiers for forensic preservation.

sections.heading: 3. Legal Framework under Cyber Security Act 2023
sections.content: Stringent penal consequences apply for identity theft, unauthorized data access, cyber terrorism, and online extortion.

sections.heading: 4. Takedown of Defamatory Content on Facebook & Meta
sections.content: Legal representation through counsel ensures formal BTRC and law enforcement subpoenas to Meta for content takedown and IP logging.

sections.heading: 5. Supreme Court Bail & Cyber Litigation
sections.content: For robust defense against fabricated cyber charges or prosecuting cyber criminals, contact Advocate Md. Shah Alam at 01712655546.

faq.question: Can cyber harassment complaints be filed anonymously?
faq.answer: Initial tips can be submitted anonymously, but formal FIR prosecution requires verified complainant identity.
